flows.title: Clone an account's automations to another account
steps: Go to Settings, then General, and click Clone This Account.
If your source account is on a paid plan, your destination account must also be on a compatible paid plan for cloning to work.

Select one of the accounts you manage in the drop-down menu. New automations will be attached to the destination account's Welcome Message, Default Reply and conflicting keywords, and your old automations stay available in the Automation section.
Click the Clone button. The system returns a note explaining that cloned content cannot easily be uninstalled afterwards, though it can still be deleted manually.
Click Clone Now to proceed. The Cloning Successful! prompt means the content reached the receiving account.
Go to the destination account and check what arrived. A new folder named after the source account is stored in the Automation section.
